title: Ekman Emotion Feature Map
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Robot Faces
description: Explain how each of Ekman's universal emotions (happiness, sadness, anger, fear, surprise, disgust, contempt) maps onto a characteristic eyebrow, eye, and mouth feature combination, by clicking each emotion and interpreting the resulting infobox.

learningObjectives: Explain how each of Ekman's universal emotions (happiness, sadness, anger, fear, surprise, disgust, contempt) maps onto a characteristic eyebrow, eye, and mouth feature combination, by clicking each emotion and interpreting the resulting infobox.
